verdict.rationale: Vanta is an API-bearing SaaS platform, so scoped agent credentials are a fair question. The evidence only shows that you can 'get an access token' and that the MCP server calls the API 'on your behalf'. Nothing documents scopes, least-privilege permissions, or per-agent credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
